definitions.explanation: A seat in a legislative body such as the Diet, a prefectural assembly, or a city council. Refers both to the physical seat and to the position or mandate it represents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{議席|ぎせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やした→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧。
⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{議席|ぎせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: They lost three seats in this election.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{過半数|かはんすう}→過半数：05610_kahansuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{議席|ぎせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{政権交代|せいけんこうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: The opposition won a majority of seats and achieved a change of government.

notes:
USAGE:
{議席|ぎせき} is the standard term for seats in any legislative body. In news and political reporting, it is used constantly when discussing elections and parliament composition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {議席|ぎせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to win a seat)
- {議席|ぎせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧ (to lose a seat)
- {議席|ぎせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧ / ⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧ (to gain / lose seats)
- {議席|ぎせき}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number of seats)
- ⟦{過半数|かはんすう}→過半数：05610_kahansuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{議席|ぎせき} (a majority of seats)
